counting_rule.rule: A stack contributes `live` COUNTED instances when its layer is visible and every enclosing group is visible, else 0: live = (stack master switch on ? number of enabled instances : 0). Counted instances are limited per layer by MAX_EFFECTS_PER_LAYER (64, pigment effect_math.rs:51) and per document by MAX_EFFECTS_PER_PLAN (4096, effect_math.rs:53). Every other kept instance (hidden layer or group, switched-off stack, switched-off instance) is UNCOUNTED: no plan counts it, but it stays in the record and Folio charges it one node, so it is bounded by this crate's MAX_UNCOUNTED_EFFECTS_PER_DOCUMENT = 4096 (effects.rs:64).

history_a5eff01.approach_chosen: Both options combined, with pigment's limits as the single owner. (1) Per layer degrade with a typed loss (the lead's option b) for a stack over pigment's 64: that is the only place a document can lose something, and it is the limit the render plan would refuse anyway (PlanError::EffectLimit), so a bigger stack could not be rendered. (2) The record-validation node budget is sized from the input (option a) inside a documented hard cap, because at pigment's own limit (4096 instances) Folio needs 4096 + one node per record layer and the caller's default is 4096: a document exactly at pigment's limit would otherwise be refused. (3) Whole-import failure only past the per-plan limit, as a typed input error (PsdError::EffectLimit), never as Proposal(..), which stays the mapping-defect family. The caller budget is not raised for anything else: inspect_bytes (document nodes) still uses cfg.budget unchanged
history_a5eff01.why_not_only_sizing: Sizing alone (no per-layer cap) would admit up to 1024 instances per layer and 8192 layers, i.e. far more than pigment accepts; the render plan would then refuse the document later. The lead's rule was to admit no more than pigment accepts

remediation_R10.rule: counted side (stacks with counted instances): per layer more than 64 counted -> effects_over_budget; the stack that takes the counted total past 4096 and every later stack with counted instances -> effects_over_document_budget (whole stack). uncounted side: the stack WITHOUT counted instances that takes the uncounted total past 4096, and every later such stack -> effects_unrendered_over_document_budget. A stack WITH counted instances whose own switched-off instances do not fit the uncounted bound (or after the uncounted side closed) is mapped with its counted (enabled) instances only, in their stack order, typed Transformed loss effects_unrendered_dropped_over_document_budget at layer[i]/tagged/lfx2(layer_id=<SLYR>), and that closes the uncounted side. Each side is a prefix of the panel order. A stack with counted instances and no switched-off instance is never reported as trimmed
remediation_R10.design_decision_for_lead: The lead clarification does not say what happens to the SWITCHED-OFF instances of a visible stack that has live instances once the uncounted bound is passed. Keeping them would break the memory bound (a visible stack with 1 live and 1023 switched-off instances, 4096 such stacks: about 4.2 M instances); refusing the stack would drop its rendered effects (the R10 finding). Chosen: keep the live instances, drop the switched-off ones, typed Transformed loss. Contained in effects.rs EffectTally::admit (Fit::CountedOnly) and map_stack (one retain)
behaviour_changes: uncounted-crossing case (R10 PLAUSIBLE): a document with more than 4096 hidden, master-off or switched-off instances: from the crossing stack on, stacks WITHOUT counted instances are typed losses (as in R9); stacks WITH counted instances are kept (R9 candidate 62d8983: lost with effects_unrendered_over_document_budget); a visible stack that also has switched-off instances is kept with its live instances only (Transformed entry effects_unrendered_dropped_over_document_budget); vs f6e5a49 (no document cap, imported fully under a caller Budget::nodes >= records + instances) such a document loses the switched-off instances / uncounted stacks past the bound only; vs the R9 candidate 4d80e50 no regression (any document that imported there has counted <= 4096 and uncounted <= 4096, so every stack is kept whole)

counted-crossing case, the other direction: after the counted total is crossed, stacks without counted instances (hidden layer or group, master-off stack, all instances switched off) are no longer refused with the counted code; they are judged by the uncounted bound (62d8983: lost with effects_over_document_budget). A later stack with counted instances is still lost whole
